accepts.description: Headless Chromium rendering + structured JSON extraction for JavaScript/SPA webpages ($0.05 USDC on Base or 5 prepaid credits).

description: Render a JavaScript-heavy webpage (React, Next.js, Vue, dynamic pricing tables, SPAs) in headless Chromium on Cloudflare's edge, wait for client-side hydration, and return strict typed JSON matching target_schema ($0.05/call or 5 prepaid credits).

target_schema.description: JSON object defining desired output keys and expected types.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL requiring full JavaScript browser rendering.

wait_ms.description: Optional extra delay in milliseconds (0-3000) after network idle for late client renders.

name: extract_dynamic_url
